Initiates or continues a conversation with the conversation exchange service.
Each call performs one synchronous round-trip by sending a text or audio request to the service and receiving the text and optional audio response.

Initiates or continues a conversation with the conversation exchange service.
The conversation exchange request and response cycle has the following steps.

1. Open a connection.

The conversation exchange service uses the secure WebSocket protocol (wss) at the following endpoint:
wss://{hostname}/api/conversation/v1/exchange/wss

After the connection is established, the client defines the event listeners (onOpen, onMessage, onClose, etc) to respond to events from the server.

2. Initiate an exc

params.name: exchange_id
params.description: Required. Valid Unique ID of the exchange item from /api/knowledge/v1/exchanges

params.name: output_id
params.description: Optional. The ranking of the answer and answer_in_context chunk, represented as best_1, best_2, etc.

items.docs: Retrieves the query and output data for an existing exchange data when supplied with an exchange_id and optional output_id.
